subject: Observability add-ons: retention tiers, tracing sampling, and pilot credits
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@datascape.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@datascape.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing: observability add-ons (retention, tracing, dashboards)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the dashboards looked great. As we start planning our production rollout, procurement asked me to outline a few open pricing questions so we can budget for H2. High level: we want predictable pricing for retention, affordable tracing for 24/7 low-latency services, and a small set of advanced dashboard seats for product managers.

Quick background on our usage:
- Peak tokens: ~30M/day (prompt + gen) across several services
- Observability ingest: ~1.1 TB/day (spikey), expected to settle to ~600 GB/day after sampling
- Traces: ~200k spans/day current, would like to increase sampling for critical services to 25% for the pilot

Specific asks:
1) Can you share recommended retention tiers and the unit economics for 30/60/90/365-day buckets?
2) For tracing, what are typical pricing levers (sampling %, per-span cost, seat-linked rates)?
3) Any pilot credit or concession you can provide while we evaluate the advanced dashboards and retention impact?

We have a looming budget review on July 8; a short commercial proposal and an idea of any possible credit path would be really helpful.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform, DataScape Analytics

---

Note: procurement included in CC for visibility.
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@datascape.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing: observability add-ons (retention, tracing, dashboards)

Samantha — really appreciate the context and numbers. High level answers below; attaching a simple model (retention_pricing_model.xlsx) that shows line-item math so you can plug alternate volume assumptions.

Summary answers (short):
- Retention tiers: we price on GB-month for stored traces/logs + per-ingest token/MB for active retention. Typical breakpoints we recommend: 30, 90, 180, 365 days. We can provide a blended slab for large annual commitments.
- Tracing: primary levers are sampling rate (percent of spans kept), span attribute indexing (charged separately), and retention. For 25% sampling on 200k spans/day, the incremental cost is usually dominated by storage and indexing; we show estimates in the attachment.
- Advanced dashboards: seat-based with a base bundle. We can include 5 PM seats in a pilot at a reduced rate or as part of a short-term credit.

Pilot credit options we can consider (examples):
- Option A: 2-month onboarding pilot — 50% off retention storage + 100k free traced spans (one-time)
- Option B: 3-month trial — full access to advanced dashboards for up to 5 seats, retention at list price but with a one-time $15k onboarding credit

Questions for you so our commercial team can tailor the SOW:
- Which retention bucket is your primary interest for the pilot? (30/90/180/365)
- Are those ~200k spans/day uniform across services or concentrated in a handful of critical services? If concentrated, we can suggest service-level sampling (higher for critical, lower for others).
- For dashboard seats: who needs edit vs view? Edit seats count toward the paid seat tally.

Next steps: if you can confirm the retention window for the pilot and whether you prefer Option A or B, I’ll draft a short SOW and a pricing summary for procurement.

Best,
Priyom
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention_pricing_model.xlsx (pricing model, per-tier math)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@datascape.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@datascape.com
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing: observability add-ons (retention, tracing, dashboards)

Priyom — thanks, that model helps. A few clarifications from procurement & infra:

- Pilot retention: we'd like to try 90-day retention for a subset (project Orion) and 30-day for everything else. If Orion costs too much, we'll scale back to 30-day across the board.
- Traces: the 200k spans/day are concentrated — ~70% from two core services (ingest & routing). For the pilot we want 25% sampling on those two services only; leave others at 5%.
- Dashboard seats: 3 editors (PMs) + 4 viewers.

On pilots and credits: procurement prefers a short-term, usage-offset credit rather than seat-freebies if it helps justify the budget line. If you can offer a usage credit (e.g., cover X GB-days or Y traced spans for 60 days) that maps cleanly to our forecast, that would be ideal.

Also: can you confirm whether indexing of span attributes (we plan to index 6 attributes per span) is charged per-attribute or as an indexing SKU?

Samantha

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procure@datascape.com
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing: observability add-ons (retention, tracing, dashboards)

Samantha — thanks for the specifics. Below is a compact commercial position we can take to procurement this week. I've also attached a short SOW draft with the pilot terms (DataScape_SOW_draft.pdf).

Commercial proposal (pilot):
- Pilot scope: Project Orion subset: 90-day retention for Orion (estimated 180 GB/day -> ~16,200 GB-month for pilot window), 30-day retention for remaining services (estimated blended 420 GB/day)
- Tracing: 25% sampling on the two critical services (~140k spans/day sampled -> ~4.2M sampled spans/month); other services at 5%
- Indexing: span attribute indexing charged as an indexing SKU; standard bundle includes up to 4 attributes per span, additional attributes billed at $0.002/span-attribute. For your 6 attributes per span, we will bill 2 extra attributes per sampled span at that rate (detailed in the SOW).
- Advanced dashboards: 3 editor seats + 4 viewer seats. Pilot price for dashboard seats bundled into the SOW for 60 days at a 60% discount to list for editors; viewers are complimentary for the pilot.
- Pilot credit: Redwood will provide a usage-offset credit to DataScape equal to $45,000 applied against retention/storage and indexing charges over the first 60 days of the pilot. This is intended to offset the one-time onboarding sizing spike and early indexing costs.

We propose Option B-ish (a short-term dashboard seat concession + usage-offset credit) because it aligns with procurement's preference for a credit that maps to forecast. If that trade works, the SOW attaches the dollarized model and a one-page acceptance section.

Next steps:
- Procurement: confirm you can accept a 60-day pilot SOW with the $45k usage-offset credit and we’ll convert into a one-off purchase order + SOW signature.
- Engineering: marissa and karthik — we need a quick runbook for the Orion service sampling configuration (service-level sampling + attribute indexing controls) so we can scope rollout and expected ingest delta. Can you confirm a 72-hour runway to produce that?

If procurement agrees, I'll loop Legal for a minimal SOW and send over the DocuSign link.

Best,
Priyom
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: DataScape_SOW_draft.pdf (short pilot SOW, credit terms, acceptance)
